title: Beat manifest
description: The `kind: project` artifact (e.g. `<draftId>-beats.pulse`) related to a pulse's video (PROTOCOL.md §8). A beat is a timestamp range inside the video: where one recorded clip starts and ends. Beats are contiguous and sum to `durationMs`.

durationMs.description: True duration of the video, in milliseconds.

beats.description: One entry per recorded clip, in play order.

segmentId.description: The recorded clip's local id on the capturing device.

order.description: 0-based position of the clip in the video.

startMs.description: Where the clip starts in the video, in milliseconds.

endMs.description: Where the clip ends; equals the next beat's `startMs`.
